events.verdict: Marshall (DAL) moves alongside Cunningham (DET) and the contact during his shot attempt is marginal.
Duren (DET) legally contests Davis's (DAL) jump shot attempt and avoids making illegal contact during his follow-through.
Marshall (DAL) avoids making illegal contact with Cunningham (DET) during his jump shot attempt.
Cunningham (DET) briefly has his hands around Marshall (DAL), but immediately removes them.
Stewart (DET) and Davis (LAL) engage and disengage as they move into the lane.
Stewart (DET) cleanly blocks the shot attempt prior to when the ball reaches its apex.
Williams (DAL) makes contact to Jenkins' (DET) arm and affects his layup attempt.
Thompson (DAL) establishes a position in Duren's (DET) path and does not deliver contact.
Stewart (DET) moves alongside Flagg (DAL) and the contact during his shot attempt is marginal.
Davis (DAL) blocks the shot attempt by Jenkins (DET) and any ensuing contact is incidental.

After on-court officials triggered replay to determine if Jenkins' (DET) shot hit the rim, the Replay Center determined that it did not. Since DAL did not secure the ball after the shot, DET's team possession continued and they committed a shot clock violation. The clock was reset to the point of interruption (28.3).
Washington (DAL) establishes a position in Stewart's (DET) path and does not deliver contact.
Stewart (DET) directly contests Flagg's (DAL) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Flagg's (DAL) hand after the release.
Davis (DAL) initiates illegal lower body contact to Stewart (DET) in an effort to reach the ball.
Cunningham (DET) reaches in and the contact with Thompson's (DAL) arm as he enters his shooting motion is marginal.
Duren (DET) moves laterally into Davis (DAL), initiating body contact that causes him to lose control of the ball.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Davis (DAL) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Flagg (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position during Cunningham's (DET) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Cunningham (DET) steps forward into Flagg (DAL), who spins away from the marginal contact and continues with his drive to the basket.
Cunningham (DET) has his hands placed against Washington (DAL), who stops short and appears to lose his balance on his own accord.
Duren (DET) grazes Davis's (DAL) arm and the marginal contact does not affect his dunk attempt.
Davis (DAL) legally contests LeVert's (DET) jump shot attempt.
Cunningham (DET) makes contact to the ball and incidental contact with the part of Flagg's (DAL) hand on the ball.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Flagg (DAL) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Washington (DAL) legally contests Cunningham's (DET) jump shot attempt.
Cunningham (DET) legally contests Flagg's (DAL) jump shot attempt. Cunningham loses his balance upon returning to the floor, but the contact with Washington (DAL) is marginal.
Flagg (DAL) moves laterally into Cunningham (DET), causing him to lose his balance before he enters his shooting motion.
While multiple players attempt to get the rebound, Davis (DAL) gets his hand on the ball and Duren (DET) pulls it away.
Duren (DET) maintains his pivot foot after gaining control of the ball.
Davis (DAL) makes contact to the ball while he is out of bounds.
Coach Bickerstaff (DET) signals for a timeout while Duren (DET) is not in control of the ball and it is not recognized by officials.
Washington (DAL) reaches in and makes contact to the ball while Duren (DET) attempts to gain control.
Green (DET) commits a take foul on Davis (DAL).
Jenkins (DET) steals the throw-in away from Williams (DAL) and the contact prior to the steal is marginal.
